in_sanskrit.name: चैत्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chaitra is derived from the Sanskrit word 'चैत्र' (chaitra), which means 'Spring, Beginning, New'. In Hindu calendar, Chaitra is the first month of the New Year, and it is also associated with the Hindu goddess Chaitanyaa, who represents the divine consciousness.

in_hindi.name: चैत्रा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Chaitra in Hindi is चैत्रा (chaitraā), which is derived from the Sanskrit word 'चैत्र' (chaitra). It means 'Spring, Beginning, New'. In Hindu calendar, Chaitra is the first month of the New Year, and it is also associated with the Hindu goddess Chaitanyaa, who represents the divine consciousness.

in_tamil.name: சைத்ரா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Chaitra in Tamil is சைத்ரா (saithrā). It is derived from the Tamil word 'சைத்ரம்' (saithram), which means 'Spring, Beginning, New'. In Hindu calendar, Chaitra is the first month of the New Year.

in_telugu.name: చైత్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Chaitra in Telugu is చైత్ర (chaitra). It is derived from the Telugu word 'చైత్రము' (chaitramu), which means 'Spring, Beginning, New'. In Hindu calendar, Chaitra is the first month of the New Year.

in_marathi.name: Chaitra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Spring, Beginning, Dawn
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chaitra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Caitra’, meaning ‘Spring’ or ‘Beginning’. This name is associated with the Hindu goddess Chaitanya, representing the dawn and the beginning of new life. It is believed that the name Chaitra brings auspiciousness, prosperity, and new beginnings.
